start.text: The new defenses are in place. All we can do now is wait, and I don't think we will wait long.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Joshua! Come look at this. Someone is trying to sign in to our accounts right now, over and over, much faster than any person could.
A.name: Carla

B.text: It's the same attacker as before. They want back in, and they will try everything they know.
B.name: Joshua

C.text: That is what makes them dangerous. I have already counted three different tricks.
C.name: Carla

D1.text: They guess passwords one after another, try one common password on every account, and use the [b][color=red]stolen password[/color][/b] they already have.
D1.name: Carla

D2.text: That depends on the upgrades you equipped. Each trick has one defense that stops it. Without that defense, the trick comes back [b][color=red]harder[/color][/b].
D2.name: Carla

E.text: Use your cards to weaken the threat and to raise your Block. When it attacks, you dodge. Keep going until it is [b][color=green]contained[/color][/b].
E.name: Carla

F.text: Understood. Let's stop them before they reach anything else.
F.name: Joshua

G.text: Everything I set up in Hardening is about to be tested.
G.name: Joshua
